description: Fluid ounces of liquid chlorine (sodium hypochlorite) to raise free chlorine by a target number of ppm, from pool volume and product strength. Formula: Available chlorine (g) = gallons × 3.78541 L/gal × ppm (mg/L) ÷ 1,000. Product (mL) = grams ÷ (strength% ÷ 100), since trade percent is grams of available chlorine per 100 mL. Fl oz = mL ÷ 29.5735.

strength_pct.description: Product strength (trade %, on the jug) (%); default 12.5

name: calc_pool_chlorine
title: Pool Liquid Chlorine Calculator (Ounces to Raise Free Chlorine)
